grain: one row per location_id and Asia/Manila local date
temporal_coverage: 2018-01-01 through the current Asia/Manila date on the spine. That end is not a maximum date span.
known_gaps: Holiday years 2018 through 2026 are transcribed from Official Gazette proclamations. The ERA5 responses for 2018-01-01 through 2026-10-25 are stored for the five pilot cities. The archive left 2026-10-20 through 2026-10-25 null. A missing weather measure stays null.
revision_policy: A content change creates a new release_id. The schema version changes only when a field meaning changes. release_id is not a public row column.
license: Weather is CC BY 4.0 and the free Open-Meteo API is non-commercial. Holiday names are transcribed from Official Gazette proclamations.
attribution: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com. National holidays as proclaimed in the Official Gazette of the Philippines.
provider_spatial_resolution: ERA5 0.25 degree cell, about 25 km. Reanalysis grid, not a station and not a measurement at a street address.
deprecation_policy: A breaking field change requires a new major dataset_version. release_id values are not reused.

columns.name: date
columns.description: Philippine local calendar date. The date changes at 16:00 UTC.
columns.transformation: Take the calendar date in Asia/Manila. Do not use the UTC date.

columns.name: location_id
columns.description: Stable approved location identifier. It is not reused for a different place.
columns.transformation: Copy the approved location key. Unknown locations are rejected.

columns.name: country_code
columns.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. The MVP value is PH.

columns.name: temperature_mean_c
columns.description: Daily mean temperature from the ERA5 reanalysis cell. Null when the source did not provide it. Not a station observation.
columns.transformation: Keep degrees Celsius. A missing value stays null.

columns.name: precipitation_mm
columns.description: Daily precipitation total. A reported zero stays zero. Null means the source did not provide a value. Negative values are rejected.
columns.transformation: Keep millimeters. Do not turn a missing value into zero.

columns.name: is_public_holiday
columns.description: True when the winning national calendar lists a regular or special non-working day. False only inside a verified complete year. An incomplete year is omitted.
columns.transformation: Use one calendar snapshot for the covered year. Local holidays and special working days do not set the flag.

columns.name: holiday_name
columns.description: Joined national holiday names. Null when is_public_holiday is false. Several names use ' | ' in alphabetical order.
columns.transformation: Trim, drop duplicate names, sort, and join with ' | '.

columns.name: is_weekend
columns.description: True on Saturday and Sunday in Asia/Manila. Monday is ISO day 1.
columns.transformation: True when the ISO weekday is 6 or 7.

columns.name: weather_source_id
columns.description: Approved weather source for this location. A missing measurement still names that source.
columns.source: Pinned location source map, otherwise the selected weather revision
columns.transformation: Use the selected revision's source when weather was staged. Otherwise use the pinned source for the location.

columns.name: holiday_source_id
columns.description: Approved holiday source for the winning calendar snapshot.
columns.source: Pinned location source map and the holiday snapshot
columns.transformation: Copy the snapshot source. A row whose source is not the pinned source is excluded.

columns.name: source_updated_at
columns.description: Latest meaningful upstream update time among the contributing weather and holiday revisions. Null when neither publishes one. Never the retrieval time.
columns.source: source_updated_at on the selected weather revision and the holiday snapshot
columns.transformation: Greatest non-null upstream timestamp. Do not substitute retrieved_at.

columns.name: dataset_version
columns.description: Semantic schema version of this row. It is not the content release id.
columns.transformation: Copy the contract dataset_version onto every candidate row.

internal_columns.name: weather_data_status
internal_columns.description: available, missing, or upstream_gap. Not a public CSV column. missing means both measures are null.
internal_columns.source: Selected weather revision, or missing when no revision was staged
internal_columns.transformation: Pass through a staged status. Use missing when the location-day has no weather revision.

internal_columns.name: release_id
internal_columns.description: Content snapshot identifier. Empty on the candidate. Not a public row column.
internal_columns.source: Assigned when a release is pinned
internal_columns.transformation: Leave null on the candidate mart.
